meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 存储常用流程定义,一两行即可重复运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复运行同一套流程,不想每次重新定义
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow definition once and rerun it in a line or two
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often rerun the same multistep pipeline without redefining it

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会把你要复用的 DAG 定义存成文件，之后你只要说出名字，它就用一两行代码调出来运行，不用每次贴一大段 JSON。
howto.when: 当你要求保存 DAG 以便复用、运行已保存的 DAG、或反复运行同一个图（如夜间/每周审计）等时触发。

say.text: 保存当前 DAG 为 nightly-audit 到 .omo/dags。
say.note: 会写入文件并试运行一次。

say.text: 运行保存过的 nightly-audit，自动加时间戳执行新实例。
say.note: 每次运行生成新时间戳，不覆盖旧结果。

say.text: 用固定后缀 20260818 运行 nightly-audit，复用上次结果。
say.note: 同 key 同图会复用旧运行，适合幂等恢复。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude save a DAG definition once as a named file and later re-run it with one or two lines, instead of pasting the full JSON each time.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a saved/named DAG, schedule a graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly), or asks where to put the definition file.

say_en.text: Save the current DAG as nightly-audit to .omo/dags.
say_en.note: Writes the file and runs it once to confirm.

say_en.text: Run the saved nightly-audit with an auto timestamp for a fresh run.
say_en.note: Each run gets a new timestamp, avoiding clashes.

say_en.text: Run nightly-audit with fixed suffix 20260818 to reuse the previous result.
say_en.note: Same key and graph reuse the old run, for idempotent recovery.
